summary: A worker covered by a proposed agreement at {workplace} can owe a fee and still have no vote on ratification.
realLife: Under the UAW proposal described in General Motors, nonmembers would make payments but could not attend union meetings or vote on ratifying the agreement.
gates: The case record identifies the historical or applicable private-sector clause, membership status and union voting rules.
inGame: needs: historical or applicable private-sector clause, membership status and union voting rules.

turns.what: Coverage and internal voting eligibility have separate entries.
The local checks eligibility under its voting rules.
